Divorced and lonely, a Uruguayan named Mario Sabah decided to realize a longtime dream for his 50th birthday and tour the world in this car. So he quit his job and fixed up the blue Méhari that once served as the family wagon. Together with a camera and his two sons, he then embarked on a 150,000-kilometer (93,000-mile) journey across 45 countries and five continents. Once on the road, it doesn't take long for tensions to mount. After a clash of personalities halfway through Latin America, Mario continues alone, all the way to Canada. Sometimes he drives 600 kilometers at a stretch without even realizing it. "Do not ask me what happened in the middle, because I cannot tell." Once he is way up north, he puts the Méhari on the boat to Spain, and from there he travels through Europe, Asia and even Australia, defying heat, rain, dirt and all forms of chaos along the way - with plenty of stamina, far too little money and at a speed that's crucial to the story. movies.title: To Tulsa and Back: On Tour with J.J. Cale
movies.description: There's not really a plot, since this is a Documentary. In my opinion, it's a very good, very entertaining, documentary of the second half of the 2004 JJ Cale Band tour. I'm Rocky, the piano player in the band. It's really accurate, factual and honest. Cale has somehow got a reputation as a recluse, which is undeserved. The fact is: he has always avoided fame, since he thinks, correctly, that fame gets in the way of freedom and friendship. For this film, he set that aside and stepped out for his fans and friends. The John Cale I have known since 1957 is the John Cale you will see in this film. Many of the mysteries people have been curious about are made plain, even the true story of where the nickname "JJ" came from (the story in the various "Histories of Rock" is inaccurate). There's plenty of really good concert footage and some charming episodes of just John, doodling on guitar and singing his songs, in parking lots and back rooms. You will get to know the supporting cast, from band members to sound guys and roadies, members of the management team and friends sitting in. This DVD is an absolute must for anybody who was ever curious about the man behind the music they love. I think the fact that the film crew came over from Munich added much to the effectiveness of the film, since they were obviously charmed by Americans and the American countryside. There's also footage from the 2004 Crossroads Festival, from the first half of the tour, and interviews with Eric Clapton, who sat in with us on the Saturday.

movies.title: M
movies.description: M is a work of art that explores the relationship between sexuality and death. These two appear to be opposite forces, but in fact they merge in all of us, disguising the fear of death or the desire to die, the world of Eros and Thanatos. In M the character of Marilyn Monroe should be seen as a symbol of this interpenetration. The actress's death is as famous as her sexuality and thus sets a perfect example of how the ancient bond between sex and death is being forever mystified and exploited by the popular culture. M attempts to explore this phenomenon in a much more personal level. All the events in the work are fictional and they are set in no particular place or time. The work consists of film material that has been produced on and off in a time period of four years, beginning in March 2013 to December 2017. The footage was shot mainly in the home and grounds of Casa das Musas Art House in Nazare, Portugal. Other shooting locations were Litibu village in Mexico and Uusikaupunki, Finland. All the actors in the work are non-professionals and were chosen because of their strong essence and character. Although the work is based on a script the roles and events were adjusted to fit the actors presence, and all of the dialogue was acted by the artist herself as voiceover. At times the process of filming was on the verge of improvisation and therefore only the afterwork would fully determine how some of the scenes developed. This way of working turned out to be a crucial element of the work. M is not an attempt to tell a story or redefine a character. In fact it is quite the opposite. The elements of film are being used as pathways for the artist to move in and out of the characters, each character representing somewhat a side of the artists own fantasy. By placing herself in the part of an object of fantasy the artist strives to understand the unity of sex and death, not merely as a myth in popular culture, but as an integral part of humanity.

movies.title: Afropunk: The 'Rock n Roll Nigger' Experience
movies.description: Afro-Punk explores race identity within the punk scene. More than your everyday "Behind the Music" or typical "black history month" documentary, this film tackles hard questions, covering issues such as exile, loneliness, inter-racial dating and black power. We follow the lives of four people who have dedicated themselves to the punk rock lifestyle. They find themselves in conflicting situations, living the dual life of a person of color in a mostly white community.

movies.title: The Great Rock 'n' Roll Swindle
movies.description: A rather incoherent post-breakup Sex Pistols "documentary", told from the point of view of Pistols manager Malcolm McLaren, whose (arguable) position is that the Sex Pistols in particular and punk rock in general were an elaborate scam perpetrated by him in order to make "a million pounds." Silly and hard to follow at times, but worth seeing for some excellent Pistols concert footage, some wickedly amusing animated sequences, and Sid Vicious' eerily prophetic performance of "My Way."

movies.title: Rock 'n ' Roll Made in Mexico
movies.description: The History of Mexican Rock and Roll..

movies.title: R A N D, inc.
movies.description: Seven best buds must discover what to do in life and in this movie or risk wasting it. They'll be sure to make dad jokes and crucify your brain cells along the way. Rand has to learn to lead his friends and stand up to Stan, all while looking for the plot of the movie. However, Stan has his own plans for the movie's plot.

movies.title: Flying Saucer Rock 'N' Roll
movies.description: 1957. A happy time of big fins, Rockabilly music and innocent teen love... Until the Martians come. In one night three teenagers have their world turned upside down when threatened by Zombie Beatniks, hopped up on space weed and bent on harvesting earth women for Martian demise. Only our square hero Johnny Keen, with help from his beatnik friend, Maynard, can defeat them. But can Johnny become "cool" enough in time to save his girl, Susie, and the day?! Drenched in Rockabilly music and greaser culture, "Flying Saucer Rock N Roll" is one swell ride from start to finish.

movies.title: O
movies.description: An update of Shakespeare's 'Othello' with a young cast, set in an upper class prep school, and centered around basketball player Odin.

The only thing that will help to solve the case is the videos recorded with their cell phones.

movies.title: Daddy O, Baby O!
movies.description: Middle-aged bachelor Mario spent his life taking care of his eccentric sister Brenda. He sells goodies in a mobile cart for a living. His daily routine gets a turnaround when his dying friend Arnold makes him promise to take care of his daughter Anna. But Anna is not an ordinary little girl. Despite her angelic look, she's mischievous and in search of her estranged mother.

movies.title: O Sol - Caminhando Contra o Vento

movies.title: O adelfos mou... o trohonomos

Irineu Evangelista de Souza in 1867 had $155.000 contos de reis, meanwhile the Brazilian Governement annual budget was 97.000 contos de reis. The movie shows his life from poverty to riches and back to poverty again, as is common in Brazil, rich people die poor.

movies.title: O Mágico e o Delegado

movies.title: O Parto Que Destruiu o Chefão
movies.description: Grávida de nove meses, Alessia é mantida em cativeiro pelo próprio marido, Vito Falcone, que a obriga a adiar o parto para garantir que o filho da viúva de seu irmão nasça primeiro e herde o território da família. Ignorando seus apelos e colocando a vida da esposa e do bebê em risco, Vito escolhe proteger a outra mulher. Quando finalmente decide libertá-la, já é tarde demais: Alessia e o filho desapareceram, deixando-o diante das consequências irreversíveis de sua traição.

movies.title: O loustrakos

movies.title: O Cavalariço Governa o Reino.
movies.description: O herdeiro Roland Valen é forçado a se esconder após uma força misteriosa aniquilar sua família. Depois que a nobre Isabella o acolhe como cavalariço, ele passa dois anos ocultando as mortais habilidades de combate no polo que o fizeram temido em todo o reino. Mas, quando um implacável príncipe estrangeiro toma Isabella como alvo e ameaça a Casa Astra, Roland precisa sair das sombras e provar que o cavalariço que todos desprezavam é muito mais perigoso do que parece.

movies.title: Despertar: O Mundo o Espera
movies.description: Há seis anos, o presidente da Associação Mundial de Neurologia recusou convites de instituições médicas de elite para se dedicar a uma única missão, garantir a recuperação de uma pessoa extraordinária. Durante esse período, essa figura permaneceu em um quarto de luxo, com sua condição envolta em mistério. Não se tratava de um paciente comum – seis anos atrás, essa pessoa havia mudado o curso da história. Agora, com o despertar iminente, o mundo está prestes a testemunhar o retorno de uma lenda, cujas ações prometem transformar a realidade e trazer mudanças sísmicas.

movies.title: Confronto o Roteiro, Encontro o Amor

Enquanto Henrique tenta reparar seu erro, ela prova que uma vítima pode se tornar protagonista.

movies.title: O Guarani

movies.title: Entre o Gelo e o Amor
movies.description: Lena, uma talentosa patinadora artística, muda-se para Nova Rosa e descobre que seu namorado virtual é o capitão do time de hóquei de seu irmão. Entre identidades reveladas, ciúmes e a pressão da fama, ela precisa escolher entre o amor e o sonho de brilhar novamente nas pistas de gelo.

movies.title: O Sakaflias
movies.description: 1935. Giorgos Sakaflias has the reputation of the toughest man of Trikala. He loves the beautiful but poor Lenio, while the rich Nora wants him. Nakas, who wants Lenio his own, will blame Sakaflias for the murder of Smyrnia's prostitute. Nora, too, when she does not succumb to her appetites, will blame him for rape. Sakaflias will leave from Trikala. The police will ring him and start looking for him.

movies.title: O Tronco

movies.title: O tzitzikas ki o mermigas
movies.description: Two partners and polar opposites have a different point of view towards life. The one is only interested in saving for a rainy day, while the other, prefers living for the moment. What would happen if they swapped places with each other?

movies.title: Raul: O Início, o Fim e o Meio
movies.description: The film tells the story of Raul Seixas, a Brazilian rock legend. The documentary unveils by rare archival images, meeting with family, conversations with artists, producers and friends, the trajectory of the artist, who died in 1989.

movies.title: O gerontokoros
movies.description: Above all, the confirmed bachelor, Thanassis Baroutsos, loves his freedom, unaware that someone has devised a plan that leads straight to church. The stage is set for the perfect entrapment; but, can Mr Spinster renounce his former self?

movies.title: The Sun Is Also a Star
movies.description: A hopeless romantic ambivalent about his future in medical school falls for a hard-luck young woman who doesn't believe in love.

movies.title: O Encontro
movies.description: Lisbon, 2003: a series of workshops and seminars about interculturalism and the performing arts takes place during a whole summer month, led by anthropologist André Lepecki with guest choreographers and dance teachers from a multitude of countries.

movies.title: O Juízo
movies.description: A man facing several crisis in his life after losing his job and dealing with alcoholism decides to move to a farm, owned by his grandfather. Followed by his wife and child, the turmoil in his life increases in strange ways when the phantoms of two slaves comes to haunt the place seeking revenge on the man's forefathers.

movies.title: O Desejado
movies.description: João is the spiritual heir (the term he prefers to bastard) of Manuel Brandão, his dying godfather, and at the same time the political leader of a small party of a disintegrating governmental coalition.

movies.title: O mestre e o Divino
movies.description: Two filmmakers portray life in the village and in the mission of Sangradouro, Mato Grosso: Adalberto Heide, an eccentric German missionary, that soon after the contact with the Indians, in 1957, starts to film with his Super-8 camera; and Divino Tserewahu, a young Xavante filmmaker, that produces films for television and cinema festivals since the 90's. Shifting between complicity, competition, irony and affect, they give life to their historical records, revealing peculiar back-stages of indigenous catechizing in Brazil...

movies.title: O Fim e o Princípio
movies.description: A film starting from naught. With no prior research, no characters, no sites, nor specific themes, a film team arrive to the hinterland of Paraíba state in northeastern Brazil in search of people with stories to tell. In the village of São João do Rio do Peixe they come to Sítio Araçás, a rural community of 86 families, mostly relatives. With a girl from Araçás as mediator, the residents, in their majority, elderly, tell their life story, marked by popular catholicism, by a hierarchy, by a sense of family and honor - in a world fast disappearing.

movies.title: O Quarto
movies.description: An ordinary forty-year old man living alone in a small, drab apartment faces the imminent loss of both his job and his eyesight. An unexpected affair with a beautiful, idle and bored socialite becomes his last hope.

movies.title: O' Schwarzwald, O' Heimat
movies.description: After a burn-out Karl spends time in his home region, the Black Forest. His car gets lost and is picked up by penniless magician Amadori who enjoys posing as wealthy entrepreneur Karl while Karl reunites with the love of his youth, Liesl.

movies.title: O emiris kai o kakomoiris
movies.description: An Arab monarch arrives in Athens accompanied by his wife and his beautiful daughter, who falls in love with a charming background actor. Of course, the princess is unaware of his innocent ruse. What will happen when the truth comes out?

movies.title: O Vyssinokipos, O Miki Maous & o Nikos Karathanos
O manavis
movies.description: A 'road-movie' documentary about Pindus Mountains and their people.

movies.title: O Beijo
movies.description: An architect sees his own life crumble because of an act of compassion: After being run down, a dying man requests a last wish: a French kiss. The architect obliges out of compassion, but people don't understand his gesture, and he soon becomes the talk of the town, and not in a good way.

movies.title: O retorno da luz - o início
movies.description: In 1986, 21 unidentified flying objects were detected by the radars in Brasília and São Paulo, and 5 fighters took off to intercept them. A girl is born from this moment and, 10 years later, a second one, with different views of the world, ability to heal and move objects, and much superior intelligence, which can affect everything and everyone around her, bringing with them, the return of light.

movies.title: O Carteiro
movies.description: Victor (Candé Faria) is a postman in the interior of Rio Grande do Sul and has the habit of opening the correspondence of the residents. In love with a new resident of the city, the young Marli (Ana Carolina Machado), who exchanges letters with her boyfriend, Victor begins to control the letters between the couple and ends up interfering in the couple's relationship.

movies.title: Quando o Amor Erra o Nome
movies.description: Evelyn, traída pelo namorado, afogou as mágoas no álcool e passou uma noite com o piloto Grayson. Separados pelo destino, ela esqueceu seu rosto, mas ele se apaixonou. Ao achar o crachá dela, o assistente errou e entregou a colega Katie, que fingiu ser Evelyn.

movies.title: O Zelador
movies.description: O Zelador explores the life of Master Russo who lives with him family in a tough suburb of Rio de Janeiro. At a young age Russo discovered the value of Capoeira. The music, physical agility and philosophy of this Afro-Brazilian martial art and cultural phenomenon helped him endure a life of hardship and danger.

movies.title: O Mandarim
movies.description: The history of Brazilian popular music in the 20th Century, focusing specially on the life and works of intriguing singer Mário Reis, a loner who, with his special way of singing - whispering and softly saying the words - in a time when singers with potent voices ruled, was in a way a forerunner of Bossa Nova style.

movies.title: O Teos kai o Stavros
movies.description: In the island of Syros, his place of residence, filmmaker Stavros Kaplanidis meets writer Teos Romvos. The two of them have come a long way together: schoolmates, Paris in the years of the military junta, in the alternative culture hangouts, Exarchia in the Metapolitefsi years... A life's sum up that etches the joint portrait of two free-spirited artists of anarchist ideology, who were never pinned down on labels both in life and in the arts they loyally served.

movies.title: O kouklos
movies.description: When the cousins of a lively man throw a party as a pretence to invite the nieces of a strict captain, he poses as the boys' rich aunt, to help them get married. But, what happens if the girls' guardian takes a fancy to the hunk in drag?

movies.title: O Picasso
movies.description: A look at the life and works of Picasso.

movies.title: O parthenokynigos
movies.description: Insurance agent has to make sure there is no payout on chastity policy .

movies.title: O Touro
movies.description: A Portuguese girl arrives at the Lencois Island, in Brazil, curious about this new place surrounded by huge white sand dunes. Its residents are all descendants of King Don Sebastian, who disappeared in the 16th Century.

movies.title: O Diamante
movies.description: Disagreements between brothers and marital infidelity are just some of the consequences that the discovery of a valuable diamond causes.

movies.title: O Secunda
movies.description: One second it's all it takes for lives to unravel, either you loose everything you hold dear or you get a new chance.

movies.title: O Pão Que o Diabo Amassou
movies.description: A ruthless loan shark doesn't realize the evil that he has done to his own family: his son is waist-deep in resentment, and his daughter- married to an unsuccessful lawyer - ends up prostituting herself.

movies.title: O pappous mou o Papaflessas
movies.description: A tender look at the hero of the Greek Revolution of 1821. Papaflessas traveled to Constantinople in the age of enlightenment and romanticism, and became a member of the revolutionary organization "Filiki Eteria" (Society of Friends), taking on the task of inciting his compatriots against the Ottoman Empire. What sets the heroes apart? Can their mistakes be justified?

movies.title: O apostatis
movies.description: An old man meets with a young hippie and they agree that the latter one will go to the old man's home. When he does, he starts having intimate relations with his wife his sister and their maid at the same time.

movies.title: O Forte
movies.description: An engineer returns to his hometown to demolish an old fort. In the return he is confronted with his past and his love of youth.

movies.title: O pio kalos o mathitis
movies.description: A businessman who balances between legality and illegality can't persuade his rightful employee to overlook his financial discrepancies. To succeed, he enlists the help of a beautiful woman; however, what happens if she, too, fails?

movies.title: O Cortiço
movies.description: This adaptation of a classic Brazilian novel focuses on the relations of charismatic characters within a tenement.

movies.title: Molly O'
movies.description: An Irish washerwoman's daughter falls in love with one of America's most eligible bachelors, much to the chagrin the young doctor's fiancée. The two girls attend a masked ball in similar costumes, where Molly is mistaken for her rival.

movies.title: O Desafio

movies.title: 'O re

There is a sandpit near the community, a place where spirits talk and coexist with the inhabitants of Guajará since its origin. Noemia, in turn, Xavier's mistress, who lives with a leprous woman who has long since cared for, reveals to him that she no longer intends to be his mistress. Glorinha goes with her father to a deserted beach, where she makes insinuations that she loves him and, when kissed by her father, runs desperately and tells her mother that her father had tried to rape her. Meu mundo virou uma bagunça de café derramado e sentimentos confusos, e agora estou presa entre dois homens incríveis.
De um lado, o Simon, meu chefe misterioso, tão sedutor quanto perigoso — um vampiro que prometeu me ensinar a dominar minha magia.
Do outro, o Michael, meu melhor amigo, gentil e leal... Mas ele esconde um segredo terrível: é um caçador jurado a destruir tudo o que Simon representa.
Os dois me querem. E quanto mais forte fica a minha magia, mais intensa se torna a chama entre nós. Como vou escolher, se os dois conhecem meus segredos mais sombrios?

One day, the werewolf confronts Branca Justiça (White Justice), who summons benign forces to scathe them and frees him of his own wickedness.

movies.title: O Reencontro é o Acidente Mais Bonito
movies.description: Lu Sihan é filha de uma família rica. Após seu pai ser assassinado e preso, sua família caiu em desgraça, e ela quase foi morta por um adúltero. Fugindo do perigo, Lu Sihan trabalhou enquanto rastreava o verdadeiro assassino que incriminou seu pai. Três anos depois, seu ex-namorado Jiangnan Hao reapareceu em sua vida. Lu Sihan sempre suspeitou que seu ex-namorado havia incriminado seu pai, então os dois iniciaram um padrão de amor e ódio. Lu Sihan e Jiangnan Hao, esse par de inimigos felizes, enfrentaram muitas disputas emocionais, ao mesmo tempo em que expuseram a mão negra por trás da armação contra a família Lu.

movies.title: O teleftaios partizanos
movies.description: An integral part of Greek folklore, Manolis Glezos is best known as the man who tore the swastika flag from the Acropolis during the Nazi invasion in 1941. Since then he has lived a mercurial existence; often caught between moments of glory and controversy as he continued to battle for his ideals. With the country knee-deep in a crushing financial crisis, Glezos is back in the limelight, elected as the oldest member of the European Parliament in 2014, at the age of 92. Yet he won't even discuss "the flag incident" refusing to be pigeonholed as a one-hit-wonder. Scolding, lecturing and joking along the way, he develops a tug-of-war relationship with the filmmakers, as they uncover the man behind the myth.

movies.title: O Laranjal

movies.title: "P-Pangit!" binara ang pagkanta ni JACKIE! | It's Showtime
movies.description:
It's the first day of school para sa maraming estudyante. Raise your hand kung excited kang bumalik sa classroom suot ang uniporme! Dito sa "It's Showtime," may extra points ang mga bibo. Don't worry dahil exam, kailangan lang pasado ka sa vibe check!

Kapag um-absent sa klase, mag-submit ng Excuse Letter kay ma'am! Si Vice Ganda, parang class adviser ang tanungan kay Vhong Navarro, na um-absent daw dahil sa ubo? Biro ni Meme, may nakarating sa kanyang kuwento. Ang sakit daw ni Vhong, hindi lang basta ubo? Sabi naman ng Mr. Suave, hindi gano'n ka-OA! He's perfectly okay!

Rated P! As in PASADO ang mga P-POP cuties na kasali sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena. Present ang WRIVE, 1621, VXON, AJAA, Cloud 7, at YGIG. Kalahati ng mapapanalunan ng lucky player ay ido-donate sa Helping Hands Healing Hearts Ministries.

Dahil P-Pop members ang bisita, kantahan at sayawan ay hindi mawawala. Nagpakitang-gilas sina VXON Sam at Franz, at nagbigay ng advice sa mga aspiring P-Pop stars. Pero kung si Jackie Gonzaga ang mag-o-audition, biro ni Meme, hindi papasa dahil P-Pop, as in P-Pangit ang boses ni Jackie. Aray naman, Meme!

Umaray rin si Vice Ganda nang mapag-usapan ang role ni Franz sa grupo. Dahan-dahan lang daw sa pagsabi ng 'MAIN VOCAL.' IYKYK. Baka pwedeng 'mang-aawit' na lang?

Pagkatapos ng fun challenges, si um-arrive ang swerte para kay Ishiro ng grupong WRIVE. Sinubukan ni Kim Chiu na kumbinsihin si Ishiro na tanggapin ang Li-Pot offer. Pero, nag-goodbye siya agad sa P20,000 para sa chance na sagutin ang P100,000 POT question.


Kung first day ng school para sa ibang estudyante, first day rin ng Grand Finals ng Tawag Ng Tanghalan Ika-10 Taon.

Sa unang araw ng bakbakan, sina Crisler Aporbo (Region XIII), Timmy Go (CAR), at Charlie Palalisan (Region XII) ang naglaban-laban,

Swabe ang tama ng performance ni Crisler, na binigyan ng bagong tunog ang classic OPM rock song na "Laklak." Dahil papalapit na sa dulo, itinodo na ni Timmy ang talento at ginawang mas masarap ang tunog ng "Saving All My Love For You." Abot-langit naman ang feels sa mapusong pag-awit ni Charlie ng "In The Stars" by Benson Boone.

Para sa Grand Finals, magkakaroon ng Round 2 ang bawat laban. Muling nagharap ang Top 2 scorers of the day, sina Charlie at Crisler. Sa ikalawang round, parehong naging mapuso ang pag-awit ni Charlie ng "Kung Wala Ka" oroginally by Hale, at ni Crisler, na ginawang ballad ang "Di Ko Na Mapipigilan" ng The Sexbomb Girls.

Parehong nagbigay ng matinding laban pero sa araw na ito, isa lang ang pwedeng umangat sa tanghalan. At ito ay si Charlie, na nakakuha ng score ng 93%.

movies.title: It's Showtime
movies.description:
Kung may isang alamat na hindi nakakasawang balik-balikan, ito 'yung alamat na masarap panoorin habang sila'y kumakanta at nagsasayawan. None other than P-Pop group, ALAMAT, na nagbabalik ang grupo sa 'It's Showtime' studio para i-perform ang Luzviminda,

Walang basaan dito pero bubumuhos ang swerte at good vibes kasama ang mga taga-San Juan City (na kilala sa 'Wattah Wattah' Festival) sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena.

Naglaro rin sina Teddy Corpuz, Darren Espanto, Jackie Gonzaga at Ryan Bang. Si Jackie lang ang nakatawid sa 'You Gotta Lyric,' kung saan tama naman ang sagot niya, pero pabirong idineklarang "wrong" ni Jhong Hilario dahil sintunado. To the rescue naman si Darren para itama ang tono! Dackie moment na ‘to!

Samantala, na-touch ang Showtime hosts sa kuwento ng buhay ni Wo, isang delivery rider na laki sa lolo. Habang itinataguyod ang sariling pamilya, gusto rin niyang maibalik ang sakripisyo ng lolong nagpalaki sa kanya. Samantala, 'extra' ang banter nina Kim Chiu at Jhong na nauwi pa nga sa dilatan ng mga mata. At syempre, kanya-kanya silang entry ng jokes tungkol sa pangalan ni Wo!

Very good din si Tate, ang tricycle driver na sweet lover kay misis, at may malasakit din sa kapwa. Minsan na niyang pinatunayan ang kabutihan nang ibalik ang gamit na naiwan ng pasahero. Kaya ang madlang girls sa studio, na-in love kay Tate! 'Yun nga lang, si misis, umapela, "Sorry po, married na!"

Luck ay na-attract ni Margo, ang hairstylist na 'di nauubusan ng kuwento. Pati tungkol kina Ogie Alcasid at Anne Curtis, meron siyang 'chismis.' At shoutout sa mga ex niya, hanggang tingin na lang daw kayo sa kan'yang ganda! Umabot sa P35,000 ang Li-Pot offer, na tinanggap ni Margo. Tama ang pinili ate n'yo dahil nang subukan niya ang P350k Pot question, akala niya'y 'simple' lang pero hindi pala niya alam ang kasagutan.

It's time for Region 1 to shine sa second week ng ika-10 taon ng "Tawag Ng Tanghalan."

Ang unang kalahok ay mula Laoag City, si Jeanel Silvestre, na nagpamalas ng husay sa entablado, singing Juan Karlos ‘JK’ Labajo's "Demonyo." Katulad ng idol na si JK, nagsusulat din ng kanta si Jeanel, na bet 'piratahin' ni Ogie nang magustuhan ang sample ng self-composition nito. Speaking of songwriting, may tip si Ogie tungkol d'yan.

Ang awit daw ay hinuhugot sa sariling kuwento, parang si Louie Ocampo, na binuo ang "Tell Me" mula sa sariling karanasan. Binalikan din ng 'Showtime' family ang iba pang iconic songs na nilikha ng maestro. Proud din si Ogie dahil komposisyon ng kanyang kaibigan

ang napiling bagong theme song ng isang airline. Chika niya, isa siya sa napakaraming tinalo ni Sir Louie sa paggawa ng theme song na 'to.

Samantala, napabilib ni Jeanel sina hurado Jonathan Manalo, Bituin Escalante, at Maestro Louie. Para sa kanila, strength ni Jeanel ang pagiging chill nito, at ang magandang tone.

Mula Pangasinan, lumuwas si Shekinah Barbiran to chase her dream sa tanghalan. "Ikaw Ay Ako" ni Klarisse De Guzman ang napili niyang sandata sa laban ng bosesan. At 15, 'beterano' na siya sa pagsali ng contests. Dahil seasoned kontesera, nakita ng hurados ang pagiging relaxed niya.

Nagustuhan ng hurados ang dalawang nagtanghal pero isa lang ang aabante sa susunod na round, at ito ay si Jeanel na nakakuha ng markang 91% laban sa 89.3% ni Shekinah.

movies.title: Thank you, Meme! TYPHOON VICTIMS, nakatanggap ng P700k
movies.description:
Nabalot ng P-pop feels ang buong studio, at nabalot din ng pag-asa ang puso ng mga typhoon victims na kasali sa Laro Laro Pick, sa ikalawang araw ng 16th anniversary special na unang ipinalabas noong December 2, 2025.

Itinaas agad ni Darren Espanto ang energy sa studio with his version of "Dungka" by P-pop Kings SB19. Walang patid ang excitement as he passed on the spotlight to VXON. Present din DNA, 1621, WRIVE, and G22 to show us what they’ve got. And all the ladies in the studio, kinilig sa performance ng BGYO. Na-surprise naman ang lahat sa debut ng pinakabagong “It’s Showtime” girl group. Isang red hot version ng “Pantropiko” ang regalo nina Kim Chiu, Jackie Gonzaga, Cianne Dominguez at Anne Curtis–the SWT16. Sino ang bias mo? Present din sa studio si BINI member Gwen Apuli para mag-cheer sa buong P-pop community.

It’s the season of giving! Maagang pamasko ang handog ng “It’s Showtime” sa mga typhoon victims mula Isabela, Catanduanes, at Aurora na sumalang sa “Laro Laro Pick.” Ikinuwento nina Joan, Ayen, at Nestor ang naging karanasan sa gitna ng baha at landslide. Halos lahat sila ay nawalan ng tahanan, at may iba namang nawalan ng mahal sa buhay.

Kuwento ng kabayanihan naman ang bitbit ni Tata sa “Laro Laro Pick” arena. Isa ang pamilya niya sa mga nasalanta ng mga nagdaang bagyo. Pero nakakahanga ang kabutihan at tapang ni Tata, na kinalimutan ang sarili at mas inuna ang pagsagip sa isang matandang kapitbahay at mga alagang hayop na nangangailangan ng rescue kaysa isalba ang sariling mga gamit, na kalaunan ay sinira ng baha.

Bukod sa P10,000 na maagang ipinamigay bago magsimula ang games sa “Laro Laro Pick,” umulan pa ng mas maraming papremyo. Ang mga nakarating sa dulo ng laro, nakaipon ng P16,000. Pero ang pinakamalaking swerte ay dumapo kay Banang, ang nakapili ng lucky balloons sa PILImination round.

Sabi ni Banang, kung masaya na siya sa P5,000 ay mas lalo pang malaking tulong ang P300,000 na offer sa Li-Pot. Kaya pinili niya ito kaysa sa P1 million Pot question. Mas bumuhos naman ang luha at saya sa buong studio nang ipamigay ni Vice Ganda ang natitirang P700,000 mula sa P1 million jackpot money. Ang P700,000 ay paghahati-hatian ng remaining players na mga typhoon victims.

movies.title: Miss Q&A: Lucia, pagod nang magpanggap sa male pageants?
movies.description:
Big pasabog ang naging announcement ni Bianca Gonzalez sa August 14 episode ng "It's Showtime." Kasama ang "Pinoy Big Brother" co-hosts na sina Gabbi Garcia at Kim Chiu, ibinalita ni Bianca ang muling pagbubukas ng Bahay ni Kuya sa pinakabagong "PBB Collab 3.0." 

To mark this new and exciting "PBB" era, nakisaya ang ilan sa mga ex-housemates. From Bahay Ni Kuya to the "It's Showtime" stage, muling nagsama-sama sa isang song and dance prod number sina “PBB Collab” ex-housemates AC Bonifacio, Klarisse De Guzman, Will Ashley, at Mika Salamanca, with Kabataang Pinoy Lella Ford, Joaquin Arce, Marco Masa, at Ashley Sarmiento na mula naman sa "PBB Collab 2.0."

Sa queendom ng talakan, isa lang ang pwedeng umangat. Pero sa araw na 'to, tatlong reyna ang nagharap-harap. Ibinuhos nina Sta. Lucia Joaquin Bordado, Miukie, at CK Alcaraz Zarfl ang wit at talak na di paaawat para korona ay sa kanila tumapat. 

Nakaka-reyna rin ang mga kuwento at inspirasyon na ibinahagi nila. Si Candidate 1, stop na sa pagpapanggap, kay from male pageants, Miss Q&A naman ang sinubukan upang maipakita ang totoong sarili. 

School teacher at dating principal naman si Candidate 2. Pero ano nga ba ang mga diskriminasyon na hinarap niya sa karera? At si Candidate 3, naghahanap ng kalinga ng ama. Nanawagan siya sa amang German, hoping na magkita sila soon sa unang pagkakataon.
Sina Miukie at CK ang nag-face off sa Wit Lang round. First time naman ni Bianca Gonzalez na umupo bilang hurado. 

Ang mga muscles nila ay kaflex-flex! Mag-work out din kaya ang swerte para sa mga gym instructors ng Metro Manila.

Si player Nad ang patunay na palaging may second chance ang taong determinadong mapaganda ang buhay. Ang dating number one sa inuman, gym na ang paboritong tambayan. 

Katulad sa real life, nabigyan din si Nad ng second chance sa laro. Matapos ma-eliminate ang lahat ngg players, bumunot ng isang sasalang sa jackpot round, at pangalan ni Nad ang nabunot.

movies.title: Vice nalungkot sa kuwento ni nanay Rea
movies.description:
Blessings have arrived kaya saluhin mo nang may ngiti sa mga labi. Five pogi heartthrobs have also arrived sa "It's Showtime" studio kaya times five ang kilig na sasakop sa puso n'yo!

Itinanghal na New Group Artist of the Year ng PPOP Music Awards 2025, WRIVE is here para haranahin ang Madlang People with their track "Hakbang." Espesyal rin ang araw na 'to dahil may espesyal na pagbati ng maligayang kaarawan para kay WRIVE Drei. At hindi lang si Drei ang may wish, syempre, lahat sila may big goals na gustong ma-achieve. Saan ba wish 'humakbang' ng grupo?

Mula Hinulugang Taktak, magfo-fall ang swerte papunta sa mga madlang players na sumalang sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena. Kaya makisakay na rin sa trip ng mga taga-Antipolo na naglaro!

Agaw-pansin ang nakaka-good vibes na awra ni player Rea, isang caddie sa golf club kung saan naglalaro si Ryan Bang. Ang ating oppa, nabigla sa pambubuking ni Rea, na sinabing galante siya at "mahilig sa magandang caddie." Napangiti na lang si Ryan, sabay depensa sa sarili, "Hindi ako 'yun!"

Pero pagkatapos ng tawanan at kulitan, naging seryso ang usapan nang ibahagi ni Rea ang hirap na pagkasyahin ang sweldo nila ni mister, na isang construction worker. Hindi raw maiwasan na paulit-ulit mangutang para sa pangangailangan ng tatlong anak. Naalala tuloy ni Vice Ganda ang isang eksena nila ni Nadine Lustre sa "Call Me Mother" kung saan bumitaw siya ng linya tungkol sa pagiging ina.

Nang makita naman ni Meme si player Louie, parang nakaharap daw niya ang kanyang kabataan, na parang kombinasyon din nilang tatlo nina Vhong Navarro at Jhong Hilario! Dahil parang tropa na ang vibe ng apat, tinulungan nila si Louie na manligaw on national TV!

Mirror, mirror on the wall, who is the luckiest of them all? Si Cecille ang luckiest player na sumabak sa jackPOT round. Pero bago ang tawaran, napansin ni Vice Ganda ang 'costume' nina Karylle at Kim Chiu, na parehong may "injury." Biro ni Jhong Hilario, kung may BINI, sina Karylle at Kim naman ang BINA, as in BINAlot ng benda.

Itinodo ng BINA girls ang Li-Pot offer na umabot sa P35,000. Sa kabila ng pangungumbinsi ng Vice na subukan ang POT, mas pinili ni Cecille ang Li-Pot. Good decision! Kaya, Ate Cecille, congratulations!

Patuloy ang salpukan ng mga pambato ng NCR sa unang linggo na 'Tawag Ng Tanghalan Ika-10 Taon.'

Ang matinding bosesan, sinimulan ng pambato ng Caloocan na si Georgina Medina. Tinig niyang makabago, binigyang buhay ang "Love" ni Keyshia Cole sa entablado.

Tiwala sa sarili ay nais ibalik ni Kane Gabriel ng Mandaluyong City na buong-pusong inawit ang "You Will Be Found." Si Kane, may 'di magandang karanasan nang mag-perform sa isang big stage, kaya pakiusap ni Punong Hurado Louie Ocampo, magpatuloy lang ito sa pagkanta, "Don't give up because you have a beautiful voice." Paliwanag ni Maestro Louie, malakas ang dating ni Kane bilang mang-aawit, pero kailangan na maging maingat sa paglakas ng volume.

Sa dulo, itinanghal na panalo si Georgina sa score na 91.3%, laban sa 88.3% ni Kane.

movies.title: P-POP Domination
movies.description:
Nabalot ng P-pop feels ang buong studio, at nabalot din ng pag-asa ang puso ng mga typhoon victims na kasali sa Laro Laro Pick, sa ikalawang araw ng 16th anniversary special na unang ipinalabas noong December 2, 2025.

Itinaas agad ni Darren Espanto ang energy sa studio with his version of "Dungka" by P-pop Kings SB19. Walang patid ang excitement as he passed on the spotlight to VXON. Present din DNA, 1621, WRIVE, and G22 to show us what they’ve got. And all the ladies in the studio, kinilig sa performance ng BGYO. Na-surprise naman ang lahat sa debut ng pinakabagong “It’s Showtime” girl group. Isang red hot version ng “Pantropiko” ang regalo nina Kim Chiu, Jackie Gonzaga, Cianne Dominguez at Anne Curtis–the SWT16. Sino ang bias mo? Present din sa studio si BINI member Gwen Apuli para mag-cheer sa buong P-pop community.

It’s the season of giving! Maagang pamasko ang handog ng “It’s Showtime” sa mga typhoon victims mula Isabela, Catanduanes, at Aurora na sumalang sa “Laro Laro Pick.” Ikinuwento nina Joan, Ayen, at Nestor ang naging karanasan sa gitna ng baha at landslide. Halos lahat sila ay nawalan ng tahanan, at may iba namang nawalan ng mahal sa buhay.

Kuwento ng kabayanihan naman ang bitbit ni Tata sa “Laro Laro Pick” arena. Isa ang pamilya niya sa mga nasalanta ng mga nagdaang bagyo. Pero nakakahanga ang kabutihan at tapang ni Tata, na kinalimutan ang sarili at mas inuna ang pagsagip sa isang matandang kapitbahay at mga alagang hayop na nangangailangan ng rescue kaysa isalba ang sariling mga gamit, na kalaunan ay sinira ng baha.

Bukod sa P10,000 na maagang ipinamigay bago magsimula ang games sa “Laro Laro Pick,” umulan pa ng mas maraming papremyo. Ang mga nakarating sa dulo ng laro, nakaipon ng P16,000. Pero ang pinakamalaking swerte ay dumapo kay Banang, ang nakapili ng lucky balloons sa PILImination round.

Sabi ni Banang, kung masaya na siya sa P5,000 ay mas lalo pang malaking tulong ang P300,000 na offer sa Li-Pot. Kaya pinili niya ito kaysa sa P1 million Pot question. Mas bumuhos naman ang luha at saya sa buong studio nang ipamigay ni Vice Ganda ang natitirang P700,000 mula sa P1 million jackpot money. Ang P700,000 ay paghahati-hatian ng remaining players na mga typhoon victims.

movies.title: Vice ibinahagi ang pangarap para sa relasyon nila ni Ion
movies.description:
Oooh lala-van na lavan ang pitik ng bewang nina Baby Dolls Arianne, Chloe, Johaira, Juby, Jelai, Eriel, and Ina. To welcome their era as an official P-Pop group at kauna-unahang Hype Group ng bayan, ginanap ang Baby Dolls Day.

Present ang mga social media personalities, Kapamilya at Kapuso "PBB" ex-housemates, beauty queens, P-Pop groups, "Tawag Ng Tanghalan" alumni, "Showtime Online U" hosts, at All-Star Games Basketball at Volleyball Team para makigiling.

Pagkatapos ng Baby Dolls Day celebration, bumida naman ang beki na may talak para sa buong nation. Meet CY ng Quezon City, Fema Braganza ng Pangasinan, at BRIGIT ng Laguna, ang mga talakera na sumubok masungkit ang korona sa Miss Q and A.

Minsan ang talak, may pagka-harsh, parang comment ni Ogie Alcasid, na hindi inurungan sa puksaan si Vhong Navarro. Kaya ang ilong ni Vhong, napuruhan sa laitan!

Naloka naman ang Madlang People sa sagot ng mga kandidata sa unang tanong sa Tumpak Ganern tungkol sa karakter sa Noli Me Tangere na sinasabing ama ni Maria Clara. Ang sagot ni BRIGIT, "Nutridamus!" Kaya biro ni Vice Ganda, kapatid ba 'yan ni Nutri Bun?

Sina Fema at CY ang umabante sa next round ng chukchakan, ang Wit Lang. Pagkatapos ng talakan, ang very 'pulchritudinous', sabi ni Brent Manalo, na si CY ang kinoronahan bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era of the day.

Pumadyak ang swerte at good vibes para sa mga pedicab driver na sumalang sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Nakaka-touch ang pagiging solid Showtimer ni Tatay Doms, na may iniabot pang liham ng pasasalamat para kay Vice Ganda at sa buong "It's Showtime" family. Pero, si Kim Chiu, nagtampo, dahil wala ang pangalan niya sa sulat na ito.

Pagkatapos ng aktingan, iisa lang ang naka-survive sa laro! Ito ay si Mavin, na kahit mahirap man ang buhay ay nananatiling masayahin. Kapang P300k ang napasakanya, babawi siya sa magulang niya. Pero sapat nang pambawi ang P40,000 na Li-Pot offer kaya dito na siya sa siguradong uuwi siyang panalo.

movies.title: Miss Q&A
movies.description:
Umeksena sa giyera ng mga matatalinghaga sina Nadimunyo Lustre, Adam Lambert, Binibining Heaven Jumawan, Stacey Doroteo, at ang nag-tie na candidates last Friday na sina Nadie Marie Fernandez at Belle Tinkerbell.

Sinala ni Vice Ganda ang kuwento at talento ng mga kandidata, at super na-touch nga siya sa good news ni Heaven na babalik na ito sa eskwela. Pagkatapos huminto nang isang taon dahil sa kakulangang pinansyal, ready to pursue her college education na si Heaven, na na-inspire sa naunang payo ni Meme Vice tungkol sa kahalagahan ng pag-aaral. Nasabi noon ni Vice na gusto niyang mag-aral si Heaven, hindi para sa ibang tao, kundi para sa kan'yang sariling kinabukasan.

Naging mabilis ang pindutan at sagutan sa Tumpak Ganern round, hanggang sa tuluyang nalotlot ang dalawang crowd favorites na sina Nadimunyo Lustre at Belle Tinkerbell. Ang apat na nakasagot naman ay umabante sa Wit Lang para humarap sa playtime questions.

Mula apat, ang Top 2 na sina Nadie at Adam ang nag-face-off sa next round, ang Beklamation, kung saan pareho nilang hinarap ang tanong na, "Sa tingin mo, bakit ka binibigyan ng mga biyayang sa pakiramdam mo ay hindi mo naman deserve?"

Ihiwalay ang de-kolor sa puti, dahil baka ngayong araw ay mas bumango pa ang swerte. Pahinga muna sa paglalaba ang mga laundry shop staff mula Metro Manila para mag-enjoy sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Siyempre, hindi kumpleto ang laro kung walang Act-Song! Si Vice Ganda, trip ang eksena ni Jugs Jugueta, at tawang-tawang pina-take two pa niya! Biro naman ni Meme, bet na bet ni Ryan Bang ang eksena niya kasama si Baby Doll Ariel. Hindi rin nakaligtas si Ogie Alcasid sa kulitan nang siya naman ang pagdiskitahan.

Si Jess ang umabot sa Jackpot Round para subukang maiuwi ang ₱450,000 POT. Pero bago ang matinding desisyon, pumili muna si Jess kung sino ang pinakapoging host. Kung si Ogie Alcasid daw ang most ahndsome of them all, nag-unahan naman sina Darren Espanto, Brent Manalo, at Ralph de Leon na kumbinsihin si Jess kung sino sa kanila ang karapat-dapat maging runner-up.

movies.title: Miss Q&A Nadimunyo Lustre
movies.description:
Positive lang ang vibes sa August 11 episode ng "It's Showtime" dahil birthday ng nag-iisang Sample King, Jhong Hilario. At ang wish niya ay hindi lang para sa sarili kundi for everybody. Eyyy!

As colorful as the rainbow rin ang kilig na bumuhos sa studio dahil sa performance ng isa sa mga paborito nating musical duos—JM Dela Cerna at Marielle Montellano, na may bagong anthem perfect para sa mga naghahanap ng lambing, titled "Perfect Together."

Kung ito ay isang color palette, bright ang bawat shade na hatid ng Miss Q and A candidates. Meet Heaven Jumawan, na head-turner ang beauty. Comedy naman ang forte ng comedy bar performer na si Senyora Acero Kabakal. Ibang 'amats' din ang baon ni Nadimunyo Lustre, na asset ang out-of-this-world na mga ngiti.

Maya-maya pa, nagsimula na ang unang round, Tumpak Ganern, kung saan unang nakasagot si Heaven. At ang nakalaban ni Heaven sa Wit Lang? Eh, 'di si Nadimunyo!

Pinalakpakan ang talak ni Heaven sa tanong na, "Sino ang mas gusto mong nag-a-update sayo—jowa mo o NDRRMC?" Pero panggulat ang naging chukchak ni Nadimunyo sa tanong na, "Anong pipiliin mo—otsenta anyos ka na pero wala kang jowa, o may jowang otsenta anyos?"

Ang mga players of the day sa Laro Laro Pick, sanay sa industriya ng hospitality. Maging warm din kaya ang welcome sa kanila ng swerte? Makilaro muna kasama ang mga receptionists ng Makati.

Panalo agad sa tawanan ang kuwentuhan nina Vice Ganda at player Chinn, ang receptionist ng Glowingly Yours salon. Nataranta naman si Neo dahil sa hotel na kanyang pinagtatrabahuan, may dumating na dalawang artista. Ano ang ggawin niya kapag nag-check in sina Ogie Alcasid at Vice Ganda?

Pagkataos ng tatlong rounds ng masayang laro, si Rovie ang umabot hanggang dulo. Hindi na pinahaba pa ni Vice Ganda ang tawaran, dahil desidido si Rovie—kahit anong mangyari, POT ay kanyang susugalan!

movies.title: Miss Q&A
movies.description:
To start the month of October, nagpasiklab sa "It's Showtime" stage ang six-member Japanese dance and vocal boy band na Be:First. Sa unang araw ng Oktubre, entertainment ay libre at sagot 'yan ng mga beki na palaban sa "Miss Q and A." Walang aatrasan sa talakan sina Jouji Medina, Jane Estolora, at Ayesa Pido Quilang.

Biro ni Vice Ganda, sakto sa BER months, 'Santa Claus 'scamming' to town' daw ang bagay na kanta para kay Jouji at sa jowa nito dahil parang hindi tugma ang mga kuwento. Si Jane naman, very Barbie ang awrahan kaya pinarampa ni Meme sa harapan. Action star na nag-transition naman ang dating ni Ayesa sa paningin ni Vice Ganda, at ang boses daw nito para bang tunog tsismosa.

Araw ito nina Ayesa at Jouji dahil sila ang umabante sa Wit Lang. Nag-loading man nang bahagya, naitawid pa rin ni Jane ang talak sa tanong na, "Saan dadaan si Santa Claus kung wala namang chimineya sa bahay n'yo?" Hindi naman sa nagmamaasim pero palaban ang chukchak ni Jouji sa tanong na, "Ikagagalit ba ng sinigang na mas maasim ka sa kan'ya?"

Ang totoong naasiman, si hurado Brent Manalo, dahil sa joke ng kaibigan niyang escort, Ralph de Leon. Pinakitaan pa niya si Ralph kung paano bumitaw ng pangmalakasang joke. Naging escort of the day rin si Darren Espanto, and true to his branding, ang mga jokes ni Darren idinaan sa singing.

Sa tiangge, dapat marunong tumawad. Dapat din naka-smile lang ang nagbebenta par ng swerte ay pumasok na. Kaya sa Laro Laro Pick, sold out ang good vibes at may sukli pang jackpot para sa mga players na tindera.

Nakakuwentuhan ng hosts si Alona, na halatang-halata ang saya nang makita nang personal si Vice Ganda. Pero maya-maya, si Meme Vice kinabahan. 'Yung tingin daw kasi ni Alona, parang may bulong.

No return, no exchange, sabi nila. Pero si palyer Maye, naka-return sa game arena matapos mabunot ang pangalan niya. Naniniwala siyang kalooban ng Panginoon ang paglalaro niya sa jackpot round kung saan umabot na sa P400,000 ang POT money.

Nag-goodbye si Maye sa P40,000 Li-Pot offer at sinugalan ang katanungan na may kinalaman sa 13th month pay ng isang private employee. Higit pa nga sa 13th month pay ang biyayang dumating kay Maye dahil nasungkit nito ang POT question!

movies.title: HUGOT sa Miss Q&A
movies.description:
Bumisita ang bandang Teeth para sa isang masayang rakrakan! At kahit certified rockers ang peg, bigla namang lumambot ang kanilang galawan nang sumabak sila sa trending “Meme” dance challenge—from rakrakan to dance cuties real quick!

Rated 5/5 stars ang talak ng mga acclang rumeresbak sa Miss Q and A Resbakulawan. Hot and fierce ang arrive nina Binibining Heaven Jumawan, Rocky Cueva, at Jhon Vincent Cahulogan, na pare-parehong grateful sa second chance na sumalang sa chukchakan.

Pagkatapos ng hayop sa galing na three-way face-off, ang Top 2 na sina Jhon Vincent at Heaven ang umabante sa Beklamation kung saan napahugot naman sila sa tanong na, "May nagmamahal bang bumibitaw?"

Pati hosts at hurados, naglabas ng saloobin. Kapag talaga si Brent Manalo ang nagsabi, ramdam ang hugot at pighati. Hindi naman sinasadyang masagi ang sugat ng nakaraan ni Ryan Bang.

At para bang déjà vu from her Breaking Muse days, Verna Periwinkle flaunted her confidence anew. Bakit daw matatakot bumitaw ang katulad niyang binibining marikit kung marami naman ang naaakit? Well, napa-sorry na lang si Marina Summers dahil hindi tulad ni Verna, wala siyang reserba.

Hospitality Management students ang nagdala ng campus energy sa Laro Laro Pick! Nakilala natin si Jibi, na mahilig sa vlogging at nagbigay pa ng sample ng kanyang bartending skills na bahagi ng kanyang kurso. Ipinagmamalaki naman ni AJ ang kanyang sipag sa academics bilang isang Dean’s Lister.

Pero sa dami ng challenges, si Mahly ang umusbong na Top 1 ng batch at tuluyang umabante sa Jackpot Round, kung saan P350,000 ang pwede niyang maiuwi. Hindi natakot si Mahly na sumugal para sa P350,000 POT money.

With grace and substance ang talakan nina Kishan at Rhaine sa Wit Lang. Si Kishan, nabunot ang tanong na, "Ilang oras ang dapat itulog ng jowa mong napagod na sayo?" Sagot niya, hindi dapat makatulog sa kaiisip sa kan'ya ang ex-jowa.

Mga kwentong nakakatuwa at may hati na inspirasyon at pag-asa ang pasalubong ng mga taga-Malanday, Marikina sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Nakakuwentuhan nina Vice Ganda, Kim Chiu at Amy Perez ang isang tricycle driver, na pakiramdam ay wala ng pag-asa ang mga pangarap niya. Kaya ang payo nila, maniwala! Sabi nga ni Kim, "The world is big and so are your dreams."

Big naman ang aktingan sa inaabangan na 'You Gotta Lyric' round. Si Teddy Corpuz, tiklop sa mga lalaking malaki ang katawan. Si Jackie Gonzaga, tiklop naman sa paalala ni Ion Perez na taken na siya.

It must be the curly hair na naghatid ng swerte kay Bert, na sinugalan ang P100,000 POT money. Ano nga ba ang halamang pinakamabilis tumubo ayon sa Guinness World Records?

movies.title: Miss Q&A BEKLAMATION
movies.description:
Sa isang Sabadong makulay, mga beki na fierce ang nagpamalas ng wit at nagpalaganap ng good vibes sa unang weekly finals ng "Miss Q and A."

Kanya-kanyang paandar sa pagrampa sina Miss Jawo ng Antipolo City, Kelly Agustin ng Nueva Ecija, Elisse Kagandahan Alamo ng Quezon City, Miss Mia ng Malolos Bulacan, Andrea Jane ng Del Monte Quezon City, at Barbie Bratz Ayuda ng Trece Martires Cavite.

Agad uminit ang puksaan ng mga kandidata dahil lahat ay sumabak with full confidence. Sina Barbie Bratz at Miss Jawo, mainit ang dugo sa isa't isa. Kaya biro ni Vice Ganda, kung sino pang magkamukha, sila pa ang nag-aaway!

Mula sa anim na nagpabilisan at nagpatalinuhan sa 'TumPAK Ganern' round, apat lang ang umabante sa 'WIT Lang' kung saan self-expression at pagiging creative sa mga sagot ang naging labanan. Sina Miss Jawo, Barbie, Kelly at Elisse ang pumasok sa second round.

At mula naman sa kanilang apat, sina Miss Jawo ang Kelly ang nag-face-off sa BEKLAMATION kung saan iisang tanong lamang ang kanilang sinagot. Ito ay kung anong makeup product ang ibibigay nila sa kanilang tatay.

Parehong 'lipstick' ang naisip nilang sagot, pero nagkaiba sa lalim ng paliwanag. Mas tumatak kina hurado Alexa Ilacad, Ralph de Leon, at Nicole Cordoves ang talak ni Kelly, kaya siya ang itinanghal na Miss Q and A Reyna TalakERA of the week! Nakakuha si Kelly ng average score na 9.3, samantalang 8 naman ang grado ni Miss Jawo.

Masaya ang selebrasyon para sa mga tatay na puno ng dedikasyon. Minsan seryoso, minsan ay korni ang banat. Pero kahit magkakaiba, pagmamahal at sipag nila ay palaging sapat. Happy Father's Day sa mga madlang tatay!

Saludo tayo sa pagsisikap ni Mel, ang hardworking daddy, na walang sinasayang na oras sa pag-aalaga at pagtatrabaho for his family. Perfect naman for the celebration ang good vibes na dala ng Showtime hosts na sumalang sa bagong paboritong aktingan ng bayan, ang 'You Gotta Lyric' round.

Sina Vice at Vhong Navarro, parang na-enjoy ang 'physical' acting... parang totoo?! Heto ang siguradong totoo, para kay Mel ang araw na 'to! Matapos ma-eliminate ang lahat ng players, pangalan niya ang nabunot para maglaro sa jackpot round.

Dahil minsan lang ang ganitong experience, hindi nagpatinag si Mel na piliin ang POT question. May reward from the universe ang masisipag at matatapang! Dahil sa pagsugal niya sa POT, naiuwi ni Mel ang papremyong P300,000!

movies.title: Miss Q&A Pau Chiu
movies.description:
I-on ang playlist at maki-sound trip with hip-hop artist J Rose, na ipinarinig ang bago niyang single at ibinahagi ang kuwento sa likod nito.

Makitawa naman sa mga kandidatang laban na laban sa Miss Q and A. Sa kanilang mga talak, atensyon mo'y mahahatak! Palaban sa puksaan sina Andrea Lim ng Pampanga, Rhian Orain ng Valenzuela, at Pau Chiu ng Manila.

Ang pangalan ni Candidate No. 3, inspired by Chinita Princess Kim Chiu, na 'peg' niya at idolo. Pero sa paningin ni Vice Ganda, hindi naman si Kim ang kanyang nakikita. Para bang deja vu, namalikmata si Meme at nakita si Tado! Biro niya, "Si Candidate #3 ay nakaaway ko no'ng Season 1." Baka ito na nga ang 'closure' na inaabangan.

Hirit ni Meme, "Mga bakla, aral-aral din." Pero sa hinaba-haba man ng kulitan, may dalwang kandidata na umabante sa second round, at ito ay sina Andrea at Pau. Ang tanong kay Andrea, "Papayag ka ba na marami kang pera pero na kay Vice Ganda?" At si Pau naman, natanong kung papayag siyang maging doktor kahit madali siyang mahawa ng mga sakit.

Pagkatapos ng WIT Lang, si Andrea ang pinusuan nina hurado Karylle, Brent Manalo, at Miss Grand International 2025 Emma Tiglao, at itinanghal na Reyna TalakEra of the day.

Sa araw na 'to, mga taga-Mahabang Parang, Angono Rizal ang bumida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Kapag nagsama-sama naman ang Showtime hosts sa 'You Gotta Lyric' round, ibig sabihin, masaya ang aktingan. Si Lassy, pinagtulungan na buhatin. Teka, saan n'yo siya dalahen?

Best friends ni Christian ang mga alagang baboy dahil sila ang nagdadala sa kanya ng swerte at kabuhayan. Kaya 'pag nakuha niya ang P100,000 sa paglalaro sa jackpot round, ang mga alagang baboy, sure na madadagdagan.

movies.description:
Ang naghatid ng feels na tunay, ang 'love team' na OA magpangiti, sina ex-"PBB Collab" housemates Dustin Yu at Bianca De Vera a.k.a. DustBia. Sa pagsayaw pa lang ng "Oohh Lala Baby," ang hiyawan ng fans parang umabot na sa ibang galaxy.

Ipinamalas naman ng T-MATES ang husay ng Pinoy sa pagsasayaw, na kanila ring ibinandera sa World of Dance Dance Summit 2026 kung saan napabilang sila sa Top 6 finalists.

Buong universe ang kayang sakupin ng mga Miss Q and A candidates with their beauty and wit. Parang stars na kumikinang sina ML Tucay ng Pangasinan, Rexy Morales ng Nueva Ecija, at Dessy Baldomero ng Marikina as they slay sa pagrampa.

Si ML, beterenang kontesera na 'idol' ng mga kapwa niya kandidata. Volleyball naman ang hilig ni Dessy, ang 6-footer beauty. 'Bunot' naman ni Vice Ganda si Rexy, na super cute sa kanyang paningin. Pero ang cuteness niya, hindi umubra sa Tumpak Ganern round ung saan ‘lotlot’ ang kanyang inabot. Aray! Si Rexy, napa-cry!

Hindi naman luhaan sina hurado Marina Summers, Brent Manalo, at Nicole Cordoves dahil pak na pak ang 'chukchak' ng dalawang kandidatang tumalak sa Wit Lang round. Saksakan ng galing ang answer ni ML, kaya for today's video, sa kanya ang korona bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era.

Shining bright ang good vibes sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, kasama ang mga estudyanteng bright din ang future. Sila ang mga Dean's Lister at President Lister's players!

Nakipagkuwentuhan ang hosts kay Lauren, na nag-share kung paano napapanatiling masaya ang buhay-estudyante sa kabila ng pressure. Parang literal na 'pressured' naman si Arnel, na pinaikot-ikot nina Vice Ganda, Amy Perez, at Kim Chiu habang ini-interview.

Si Jackie Gonzaga, na-pressure naman sa dalawang manliligaw niya. Para bang 'the plot thickens' sa love triangel nila ni Brent Manalo at Darren Espanto sa Act-Song!

Pasok sa listahan ng jackpot players si Jelo, na bet maging isang newsroom staff someday. Heto ang latest news: si Jelo, natagpuang matapang at tinanggihan ang P35,000 Li-Pot offer kapalit ng pagkakataon na masagot ang P250,000 POT question.

movies.title: Miss Q&A
movies.description:
Sa pag-ibig, maraming tanong na walang kasagutan. Mapapasabi ka na lang ng, "Hindi ko alam." 'Yan ang hugot ng bandang Spongecola at ni Kai Del Rio sa pagsasanib ang kanilang mga musika't talento.

Sa Miss Q and A, talak ay hindi bitin. Busog sa wit ang mga kandidata for today's video, sina Sashi Giggle Esmeralda, Zha-Zha Divah, at Angel Grey, in their rampa and chukchak na havey.

Si Vice Ganda, namasa ang kili-kili sa daming ganap this Wednesday. From bardagulan to kantahan, parang never-ending ang kulitan. Masarap din balikan ang tamis, pati na ang pait, ng unang pag-ibig. Ang usapang crush at rejection, idaan na lang natin 'yan sa karaoke session! Kapag ba galing sa vacay, talagang unlimited ang energy? Ayun, muntik na namang mag-OT sina Meme!

Sa hinaba-haba ng mga pata-WOW, sa Tumpak Ganern round pa rin ang tuloy. Ang comeback-ing kandidata na si Sashi, bigo na pumaslak muli. Samakatuwid, sina Angel at Zha-Zha ang nagsalpukan sa Wit Lang.

Sobrang init ng panahon. Ang haring araw, talagang umeeksena! Pero mas mainit ang swerte sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Mula drawing, magkatotoo kaya ang dream 'winning' ng mga Architecture students mula NCR?

"Woke up like this" ang peg ni Kyle in his kulot-kulutan hairdo. Ano nga ba ang goal niya, and in the future, saan niya balak gamitin ang talento? Kinilala nina Vice Ganda ang Dean's Lister at scholar na 'to! Si Charz naman, eksaherada ang 'sikip' ng "Tala" dance moves with backup dancers! Ang lakas ng 'amats' ng mga estudyante, gigil n'yo tuloy si Meme!

After all that fun, si Charz, ang nag-sample ng “Tala” prod, ang umabante sa jackpot round na para bang may swerteng hatid ang ‘masikip’ na dance moves niya. Umabot ng P30,000 ang Li-Pot offer, na sobra pa sa bayarin sa eskwela.

movies.title: Miss Q&A Nunoy
movies.description:
Maligayawang kaarawan, Chief of OPM Ogie Alcasid. Bukod sa "It's Showtime" family, present to celebrate ang nag-iisang reyna sa puso niya, his forever favorite ka-duet, his misis Regine Velasquez. From the heart ang mensahe ni Asia's Songbird sa chief ng kanilang tahanan.

Imbitado rin sa episode ang isa pang hitmaker, Moira dela Torre, na ginulat ang malang people sa mataas niyang energy.

Hit at bentang-benta rin ang witty talak ng tatlong kandidata sa Miss Q and A. Break muna sa pagbubbunot ng ngipin ang dentistang si Dra. Ruth Qanal, at sa chukchakan muna siya humugot ng banat. Ima-mine mo rin ang good vibe na dala ni Dyeyzel Romero, ang live seller talakera. At agaw-eksena ang intro ni Nunoy, na para bang dinala tayo sa liga ng basketball.

Triple treat din ang attendance nina Anne Curtis, Vice Ganda, at Vhong Navarro, na hindi matapos-tapos ang kulitan at bardagulan. Anne is back, and so is her 'bulol' hosting, kaya si Meme Vice ay 'nabuwisit' sa kanyang sabaw moments.

Pati ang hosts nag-enjoy sa mga tanong sa Tumpak Ganern. Ano nga ba sa Ingles ang tanikala? At ang isang bugtong, nasagot ni Anne, but as usual, in a sosyal way nga lang!

Nag-babu nang maaga si doktora, matapos maligwak sa Tumpak Ganern round. Kaya sina Dyeyzel at Nunoy ang umabante sa Wit Lang.

From palengke, napasugod sa game arena ang mga masisipag na tindero't tindera. Pasok, mga suki, swerte ay hitik sa Laro Laro Pick.

Usapang isda muna tayo kasama si nanay Dada, na nag-sample kung paano mag-alok sa mga parokyano at pumaldo nang todo. Ang isa pang sikreto, dapat kilay on fleek upang ang customers ay maakit.

Gulay na madaling itanim at anihin naman ang category sa It's Giving kung saan dalawa lang ang natira. It's Dada versus Mila. Pagdatating sa hulaan ng title ng kanta, parehong olats ang dalawa. Kaya bumunot ng iba, at ang swerte ay kay Mie napunta.

P450,000 ang pwede niyang mapanalunan. Syemmpre, gusto ni Mie 'yan! Pero mas pinili niyang maging praktikal at tanggapin ang Li-Pat offer na P50,000. 'Yun nga lang, alam pala ni Mie ang sagot sa katanungan.

movies.title: Miss Q&A
movies.description:
Pak na pak ang mga kandidatang tumalak sa Miss Q and A Weekly Finals. Dahil sa malakas na cheer ng Madang People, napa-"and I thank you" sina Elthon Bequio, Trixie Gomez, Gabriela Duevall, Queen Sam Ri, Freda, at Kathryn Fernando Poe, Jr.

Ang mga accla, nagbardagulan at bumuo ng kani-kanilang grupo. Pero at the end of the competition, nangingibabaw pa rin sa kanila ang nahanap na bagong sisterhood... at may nahanap din na pag-ibig? Si Gabriela, na-love at first sight sa 'poganda' na si Queen Sam Ri. At totoo ba ang balita na may isang lasing na kandidata?!

Ang Top 4 na sina Sam Ri, Elthon, Freda, at Gabriela ang umabante sa Wit Lang round. At mula sa apat, dalawa lang ang nag-face off sa Beklamation. It's Sam Ri versus Elthon sa katanungan na, "Sa panahon ngayon anong mas nakakatakot, katangahan o kasamaan?"

Talak ni Sam Ri, mas nakakatakot ang katangahan dahil ito ang dahilan kung bakit marami ang nabibiktima ng fake news. "May mga taong matatalino pero nagtatanga-tangahan kaya nadadakip sila at napapaniwala ng mali," sabi ni Sam Ri.

Mula NCR, sumugod sa Laro Laro Pick game arena ang Madlang Players na nangtatrabaho sa printing shops. May isang player ba na magpapa-tarpaulin ng "congrats" dahil na-hit ang jackpot?

Ay, nakaka-in love talaga! Nakisali pa sweet-sweet-an sina Darren Espanto at Jackie Gonzaga, na pinakilig ang Madlang People sa kanilang 'rainy moment' na eksena!

Pagkatapos ng It's Giving, You Gotta Lyric, at Laro Laro Pick rounds, ang joy ay kumapit kay player Joy.

movies.title: 100% T-Shirt
movies.description: We encounter it on a daily basis. Easy to produce, it is the most universal and basic piece of clothing. From Paris to Tokyo, including Ouagadougou, we all own at least one T-shirt: to sleep in, to run in, to work in, to express ourselves artistically, or to promote our political beliefs. The T-shirt has gone from undershirt to personal medium and creative outlet. Over 50 years, it has achieved a special status and is one of our best-selling pieces of clothing. How did the T-shirt enter the fashion world? If Marlon Brando seduced women around the world with his sweat-soaked T-shirt in A Streetcar Named Desire, it's James Dean in Rebel Without a Cause, who launched the white T-shirt as a fashion item. Since then, the T-shirt has continuously been modified, and each of its forms, be it torn, oversized, screenprinted or tie-dyed, reflects the evolution of our society. 50 years and tens of billions of copies later, the T-shirt undoubtedly deserves a film which explores its fate with curiosity, humour, and a dose of criticism...

movies.title: Duh u mocvari
movies.description: A brother and sister, Miron and Melita, go to visit their friend Zoltan (Liptus) in Kopacevo for winter vacation. The same night Miron and Melita arrive, a boy named Halasz is found half-frozen at the edge of the swamp where, he raves, that he was attacked by a white ghost on one of the islands of the swamp. From then on, he can no longer talk. The old woman Etelka reveals the secret that the ghost had been first seen long ago and that you cannot go to the island because the ghost wreaks vengeance on anyone stepping onto the island. Fear takes hold in the place. The hunters, with Vucevic, Kovacevic and Levay taking the lead, begin an investigation however neither they nor the doctors can help Halasz. movies.title: U Turn [Hindi]
movies.description: Raveena (Chanu Dissanayake), a news reporter working on an article on the incidents at a flyover. She also has a crush on the crime reporter Adithya (Thumindu Dodantenna), whose help she seeks for research material on accidents on the flyover. She finds that each day some motorists move the concrete blocks that partition the road just to take a quick U-turn and avoid the traffic. They don't move them back and the blocks are left to lie randomly on the road leading to many accidents. A beggar sitting on the flyover notes down the vehicle numbers of bikers who violate the rule to take the U-turn. Then he gives the list to Raveena. She obtains the details of the culprits using her contact in the traffic department, with the intention of confronting them for their "short-cut" and writing an article for the paper. Her attempt to meet the first person on the list goes in vain. Later the same day, the police take her into custody and accuse her of killing the same person she wanted to meet. She is shocked and tells her side of the story. Though the senior police officer rejects it, sub-inspector Ranga (Hemal Ranasinghe), finds it believable and does some investigation. It is revealed that all the persons Raveena has on her list have committed suicide. They also noticed that they have committed suicide the same day they took the wrong "u-turn". Raveena and Ranga find another number has been noted by the beggar which is to be delivered to Raveena the next day. The duo trace the address and try to rescue the man, a lawyer (Rana Madhav) , who has taken the u-turn on the same day. As nothing seems suspicious, both leave only to encounter the very death of the lawyer whom they came to rescue.

movies.title: U me dobrý
movies.description: A poetic comedy set in a pub situated on an inlet and called At the Ferryman's, which is run by pub-keeper Tonda (Jirí Schmitzer) and his companion Andula (Lenka Vlasáková). Among the pub-goers is Kája (Miroslav Vladyka), who compensates for his tendency to gamble (thanks to which is marriage is on the rocks) by playing cards at the pub with his friends. Besides his salary as a security guard at an art gallery, he has saved a pretty penny over the years by posing as a chimney sweep for newlyweds' photos, and now he wants to use it to give his wife (Simona Babcáková) a long-promised seaside holiday, a promise which breathes new life into their relationship. But in a moment of weakness, Kája loses all of his savings playing the shell game at the marketplace. So as not to lose the rekindled love of his wife, he requests the help of his friends from the pub. Combining their forces, they eventually manage to slam the shell-game gang and recover his money. The whole experience has a profound effect on Kája, who learns a lesson from the scare, confirms his friendship with the others, and realizes just how important they are to him.

movies.title: Mee Aani U

Abhishek and Ira meet through Facebook (Social Networking).Initially it's a game of hide and seek with their fake facebook profiles. After a while it moves from internet to mobile, Chatting to Texting sharing each and every information with harmless flirting. With day-to-day sharing and caring, lovely Ira starts getting involved with the playful Abhishek.But this is not why our story is exceptional. Even though over internet they are in love but in person they hate each other. Will Abhishek change for his love? Will Abhishek and Ira realize their love for each other? And if they do how will they realize? A Fun, Twisted love story with a Fresh treatment. Youth oriented, full on dhamaal Masala is...''Mee Ani U''

movies.title: The Care They've Earned
movies.description: It is a gripping look into six proud veterans' experiences with the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Veterans Health Administration (VHA) as they seek to manage the mental and physical trauma they sustained in uniform. The documentary details their experiences with an embattled VA - from botched surgeries to misdiagnoses to personnel shortfalls - and educates about the fundamental changes and reforms that are needed to ensure our veterans are taken care of in a way that honors their service. It asks viewers to reflect on serious and complex questions about what kind of care our veterans have earned after they hang up their uniforms and when, how, and where they receive that care. The Care They've Earned tells the stories of six veterans, but it highlights the struggles of finding adequate health care that all veterans face. It educates about the opportunity that more choices could mean for our veterans to receive the care they need - when and where they need it.

movies.title: A.W.O.L
movies.description: Vietnam. 1972. US Army Special Forces Major Cliff Marquette leads a squad ordered to investigate unusual reports and secure a remote jungle temple locals believe has mystical powers. The Marines guarding the temple have withheld provisions for days from a Viet Cong prisoner. Despite severe mistreatment, the prisoner mysteriously shows no signs of suffering. Marquette confronts the Marine in charge, Garris for torturing a prisoner of war when suddenly enemy forces attack and mortar shells rock the temple. An exceptionally heroic, but losing battle lands Marquette in the hands of a merciless Viet Cong torturer. His men are dead; his screams unheeded. At the height of agony, Marquette's world is turned upside down. In an instant, he finds himself a stranger in the midst of an American life that apparently belongs to him - an idyllic but unrecognizable life complete with a loving wife and two children he's never seen before. Marquette struggles to take in what is happening to him. First is paranoia. Soon uncertainty and fear give way to relief and acceptance. But the twist of fate that delivered Marquette into this life from the hands of his enemy has granted him only a reprieve. The cruel pain of war is not over. As the clock strikes midnight Marquette is back in Vietnam where his torture resumes a few minutes each night. Desperately trapped between two worlds, Marquette must endure;unless, with the clock counting down, he can cheat fate. Escaping will take his wits;and it will require a gun.

movies.title: masakra w
movies.description:
Amerykański western w wersji z polskim lektorem - Masakra w Dragoon Wells.

Oficer kawalerii jako jedyny ocalał z ataku Indian. Wraz z wozem pełnym więźniów i skazańców, przemierza terytorium wrogo nastawionych Indian.

Masakra w Dragoon Wells (1957)
Reżyser: Harold D. Schuster
Scenarzyści: Warren Douglas, Oliver Drake
W rolach głównych: Barry Sullivan, Dennis O'Keefe, Mona Freeman
Gatunek: western
Kraj: USA
Język: angielski
Data premiery: 28 lutego 1958 r. (RFN)
Miejsca kręcenia: Kanab, Utah, USA

Fabuła:
Oficer kawalerii, jedyny ocalały z ataku Indian, wraz z wagonem więźniów przemierza wrogie tereny indiańskie.

Recenzje:
"„Nie jestem obiektywny, bo mam z tym filmem osobiste wspomnienia. Jako nastolatek lubiłem kolorowe westerny z popularnymi aktorami. Dziś wolę czarno-białe klasyki. Latem 1956 roku przypadkiem trafiłem na plan zdjęciowy tego filmu w Utah. Widziałem, jak kręcono kilka scen z O'Keefe’em i Cabotem. Później obejrzałem film w kinie i zaskoczyło mnie, że fabuła jest bardziej złożona niż w typowych westernach z lat 50. Nie ma tu jednego bohatera – to historia wielu postaci. Polecam każdemu, kto lubi filmy z dobrze napisanymi postaciami i solidną realizacją. Szkoda, że trudno znaleźć ten film na DVD.”
Autor: hitt_dave na IMDb.com
 

„To nie jest prosty western. Kapitan kawalerii i więźniowie muszą współpracować, by przetrwać na terenie Indian. Aktorstwo stoi na wysokim poziomie, reżyseria jest solidna, a muzyka buduje napięcie. Film ogląda się z prawdziwą przyjemnością.”
Autor: bux na IMDb.com

movies.description: Amor, desamor, envidia y traición son los ingredientes de la nueva novela Mariana y Scarlett, la historia de dos hermanas que, sin saberlo, se enamoran del mismo hombre. Mariana y Scarlett son dos mujeres de clase media, bonitas, luchadoras y con un gran anhelo de superación. Pero ahí terminan los parecidos. Mientras Mariana es seria, dulce, serena y quiere hacer todo por el camino correcto; Scarlett es divertida, pícara, agresiva y quiere hacer todo por el camino rápido. El deseo de la primera es montar su propio taller de confecciones y hacer sus propios diseños, el de la segunda es ser una modelo internacionalmente reconocida. En su camino hacia el cumplimiento de su sueño ambas se cruzarán con Roberto White, un millonario dueño de una textilera, cuyo matrimonio está roto y que, mientras consigue el divorcio, saldrá con las dos hermanas pero con identidades diferentes. Con Scarlett será Roberto, millonario y empresario, mientras que con Mariana será Boby, empleado en una agencia de seguridad. Cuando Roberto se da cuenta de que se ha enamorado de Mariana, romperá con Scarlett, pero la dicha no lo durará mucho, ya que Mariana no tardará en descubrir el engaño, lo que le llevará a romper con él para siempre. Scarlett por su parte descubre que Roberto la abandonó por Mariana, lo que hace que su relación de hermanas se afecte de manera irreversible. Scarlett y Mariana se convierten entonces en rivales por la lucha del amor de un hombre, Roberto.

series.title: The Altruists [Hindi]
series.description: Follows the tumultuous romance between FTX co-founder Sam Bankman-Fried and his girlfriend Caroline Ellison. It depicts their ambitious attempts to revolutionize the financial system, leading to a $36 billion fraud.

series.title: Percy Jackson and the Olympians [Hindi]
series.description: Demigod Percy Jackson leads a quest across America to prevent a war among the Olympian gods.

series.title: Yellowjackets [Hindi]
series.description: A wildly talented girls high school soccer team become the unlucky survivors of a plane crash deep in the Canadian wilderness.

series.title: Play with Fire [Hindi]
series.description: When Alex starts to get bored with his life with his wife Lara, and tries to find a beautiful escape, he meets Nadine who is also trapped in a complicated relationship with her husband, Erwin.

series.title: Good Partner [Hindi]
series.description: Cold and hot human court office drama between Cha Eun-kyeong (Jang Na-ra), a star lawyer whose divorce is her calling, and Han Yoo-ri (Nam Ji-hyun), a new lawyer whose divorce is her first time.

series.title: The Blue Road [Hindi]
series.description: Two detectives pursue a killer leaving mutilated bodies and cryptic messages across Japan and Korea. Korean text appears with Tokyo victims, Japanese with Korean victims, leading to an international manhunt.

series.title: Dig [Hindi]
series.description: Follows four women at an archaeological dig in Greece, each facing different life challenges. When they discover a buried secret that could change history, they become entangled in a dangerous international conspiracy.

series.title: CoComelon Lane
series.description: The adventures of JJ and his friends as they experience life as little kids.

series.title: The Detective Is Already Dead [Hindi]
series.description: Kimizuka Kimihiko is a crisis-magnet. From getting caught up in a crime scene to accidentally witnessing a drug deal, trouble seems to find him around every corner. So it is no surprise when his rather mundane flight suddenly enters a state of emergency with a dire need of a detective onboard. Unfortunately, his attempt at avoiding trouble is foiled by a beautiful girl with silver hair who goes by the codename Siesta. Declaring herself a detective, she unceremoniously drags Kimizuka into the case as her assistant. That incident spelled the beginning of an adventure around the globe that went beyond his wildest imagination. Putting their lives on the line, the two took down criminal organizations, prevented disasters, and saved thousands. But the curtain closed to their epic journey with Siesta's untimely death three years later. Resolving to live an ordinary high school life this time, Kimizuka spends a year maintaining a low profile. However, as fate would have it, a girl with an uncanny resemblance to Siesta comes crashing into his life, threatening to throw his peaceful days into disarray.

series.title: Still a Family
series.description: In 2015, Tongzhou officially became the sub-center of Beijing, and the people were very happy. Sai Duoxi's family, who lived in the alley of the old wharf of the North Canal and were doing renovation, received the demolition payment as promised. The five brothers and sisters of the Sai family quarreled over the demolition payment. In the process, the hidden problems of each family were exposed one after another. Sai Duoxi was diagnosed with a terminal illness. Facing his children who were like a pile of scattered sand, he was always unable to treat them equally, and he fell into distress and reflection. His greatest wish was to see his children live in harmony before he died, and this hope could only be placed on his eldest daughter-in-law Wen Jiayin. Wen Jiayin, the eldest sister-in-law who was always gentle and docile but determined in her heart, began to clean up the "mess" of the Sai family in the name of her family. With her efforts and inspiration, the five brothers and sisters finally corrected their shortcomings according to their father's expectations, united, turned danger into safety, and realized their father's long-cherished wish of "family harmony brings prosperity".

series.title: Miracles of the ER
series.description: Zhou Cheng-jun, deputy director of emergency medicine, brings an average graduate into his elite team. Together with Dr. He Ya-hua, they face relentless medical crises, ethical dilemmas, and internal power struggles at the hospital.

series.title: Dream
series.description: Years ago, journalist Shen Yueshui documented the lives of workers at the old Lacheng Brewery. Now, she returns to Lacheng, picking up her camera again to explore those corners forgotten by time. Cao Jun, Tu Chunyan, Qian Yichuan and Cheng Youtian were once the protagonists of her lens, yet their fates have been shaped by the passage of time. Their stories are like riddles sealed by time, and Shen Yueshui travels between the past and the present, uncovering these long-forgotten tales.

series.title: Spring of the Blade
series.description: After losing her mother as a child, Xie Qingyuan returns years later to uncover the truth and seek justice. Reuniting with Shen Run, once a fallen youth and now a righteous court official, they join forces to expose corruption and right past wrongs. Through shared dangers and unwavering support, they grow closer, devoting their lives to protecting each other and their people.

series.title: Black Clover [Hindi]
series.description: Asta and Yuno were abandoned together at the same church and have been inseparable since. As children, they promised that they would compete against each other to see who would become the next Emperor Magus.

series.title: Rana Naidu [Hindi]
series.description: In the complicated world of celebrities, Rana Naidu is the go-to problem-solver. When his father is released from prison, Rana grapples with family secrets and personal conflict and realizes that the only problem he can't fix is his own.
